objective: Choose the strongest Si-centered team available on this account; craft missing appropriate gear, equip and save a loadout, and artifice it using a costed inventory-based plan.
resume_environment: Endies emulator; leave Arkies / Arknights untouched
requires_before_spending: Finish owned-operator scan including Si and candidate teammates, weapon and Potential levels, skills, gear and existing artificing
Inspect unlocked gear recipes, current equipment, crafting currencies and materials, and artificing catalysts
Inspect saved gear-plan controls and confirm the exact item names and stats in the English emulator UI
Choose the account-specific lineup and required ultimate-energy breakpoints before selecting final pieces
Calculate crafting quantities, donor gear, catalyst costs and staged artificing targets from inventory

team.source_evidence: Prydwen Si guide Team #1 lists Arcane, Tangtang and Xaihi; its equipment list and timeline explicitly include Si as the fourth operator.
team.selection_policy: Compare owned, built lineups and actual weapons/Potentials. This published candidate is not a claim of best performance for an unscanned account.
team.arcane_form: Verify the intended INT/WILL attribute form from the matching rotation before equipping her.
team.rotation_policy: Use team-specific infliction consumption and combo timing, with basic attack strings between windows. Generic round-robin skill spam is insufficient.

si_loadout.preferred_weapon: Jade Vessel if owned; source comparison uses P1, not a required ownership threshold

conditional_variants.condition: The actual rotation needs additional Ultimate Gain Efficiency while retaining the set
conditional_variants.candidate: Type 50 Yinglung Heavy Armor T1; compare damage and energy timing in-game

conditional_variants.condition: Compare a personal-combo-damage variant against the actual available patch items and rotation
conditional_variants.caveat: Endfield Hub recommends this using its own item data, but notes missing data for a newly released Yinglung glove. Do not override the current in-game glove stats from this source alone.

conditional_variants.condition: The selected team benefits more from Si carrying the support set
conditional_variants.caveat: Compare existing teammate set coverage and Si personal damage before switching.

si_loadout.skill_investment_reference: Combo Skill > Ultimate = Battle Skill > Basic Attack; support-role priorities can differ.

crafting_and_artificing.crafting_policy: Reuse suitable owned equipment first; craft only missing final pieces and explicitly selected donor pieces.
crafting_and_artificing.artificing_policy: Verify each piece and eligible enhancement line. Compare primary-attribute and combo-damage improvements per material cost, while meeting the required ultimate timing. Use the observed donor-match quality and current upgrade/pity state.
protected_donors: Previously upgraded gear unless explicitly selected for this purpose
crafting_and_artificing.budget_and_target: To be calculated from inventory before executing staged upgrades. No fixed maximum-material run is configured.
verification: Capture final item names and enhancement levels
Verify the intended three-piece set is active
Save and re-open the named loadout
Verify selected team and Arcane form
Run a resource-farm or other appropriate combat check to verify energy, combos, survival and rewards

implementation_status.targeted_loadout_crafting_and_artificing: Offline gear planner implemented in tools/gear_workflow.py; inventory reservations, shared cost limits, four-slot equip/loadout contracts and single artifice previews. Live screen navigation remains unimplemented and unvalidated.

sources.use: Main build and team; equipment table resolves the missing fourth portrait in the team block.
Alternative damage build; explicitly incomplete new-glove data requires comparison with the client.
Reference for future inventory-specific donor and cost planning; do not infer account inventory.
